title: Simply WOW
text:
For a soccer fan, there is really little to say: simply WOW.
We visited the museum and the section dedicated to the trophies, since at the time of our visit the stadium was under reconstruction, but despite this, the experience did not disappoint us at all.
The route retraces the entire history of Barcelona, from the great legends of the club to the infinite trophies won, passing through historic jerseys and memorabilia of the players. Obviously, the famous “Messi corner” could not be missing, truly spectacular for those who have followed the club's history in recent years.
